name: bld_iterate_shrinking_unique_fixed_point
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [Nonempty X] (f : X → X) (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → dist (f^[n] x) (f^[n] y) < dist x y) : ∃! p : X, f p = p
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [Nonempty X] (f : X → X) (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → dist (f^[n] x) (f^[n] y) < dist x y), ∃! p : X, f p = p
informal: Uses Mathlib2.top_edelstein_unique_fixed_point applied to f^[n]: its unique fixed point p satisfies f^[n] (f p) = f p, so f p = p by uniqueness; any fixed point of f is fixed by f^[n]. (Shrinking analogue of Mathlib2.top_fixed_of_iterate_contraction.)
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [Nonempty X] (f : X → X) (n : ℕ), (∀ (x y : X), x ≠ y → dist (f^[n] x) (f^[n] y) < dist x y) → ∃! p, f p = p
